```yaml
name: Documentation Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "dev" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "dev" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-docs:
    name: Build Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: doc-site
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: doc-site/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run build

      - name: Verify build success
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "dist" ]; then
            echo "Documentation build failed: dist directory not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Documentation build successful"

  test-docs-content:
    name: Test Documentation Content
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-docs
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: doc-site
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: doc-site/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run content tests
        run: npm run test:content

  validate-docs-links:
    name: Validate Documentation Links
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-docs
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: doc-site
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: doc-site/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate links
        run: npm run validate:links

  lint-docs:
    name: Lint Documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-docs
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: doc-site
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: doc-site/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint documentation
        run: npm run lint:docs

  verify-documentation-changes:
    name: Verify Documentation Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build-docs, test-docs-content, validate-docs-links, lint-docs]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Check documentation files exist
        run: |
          # Verify new documentation files exist
          if [ ! -f "doc-site/src/content/docs/guides/search-to-rss.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: Missing doc-site/src/content/docs/guides/search-to-rss.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "doc-site/src/content/docs/zh/guides/search-rss-generator.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: Missing doc-site/src/content/docs/zh/guides/search-rss-generator.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify updated documentation files exist
          if [ ! -f "doc-site/src/content/docs/guides/html-to-rss.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: Missing doc-site/src/content/docs/guides/html-to-rss.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ ! -f "doc-site/src/content/docs/zh/guides/rss-generator.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: Missing doc-site/src/content/docs/zh/guides/rss-generator.md"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All documentation files verified successfully"
```
